author: ViolentBoo
body:
Hey guys, I remember the map that I made called Ahead, I got some comments that saying that it looked pretty good and that there was too much void. Well I was wondering what should I add to the map? I can't move the bases closer or else the air will overlap other bases when I use the /hpos1+2 thing. Or you guys can edit the map yourselves if you'd like, I'll give you credit. Thanks!

Images: http://imgur.com/8fLUXYj,kp61i59,1Qb2Ycv,Zm1htnW,GPLnSEx,tW5IZfU,xLuYv5D,HvJuukb,PouG1EG,hGsj4w9,TG9...
